analysis.mode: PSNR+CI (wavelet sigma=0.0; PSNR invalid for random impulse positions, content-independent CI metrics used as primary)
analysis.rationale: Single-step impulse noise. zero_ratio=0.9001 == 1-amount(0.10) matches skimage s&p severity 5 exactly; clipped_fraction=0.1006 independently confirms 10% element replacement; 90% of pixels are bit-identical to clean, which rules out any blur/JPEG/contrast/saturation/brightness step (block_boundary=0.996, unique_G=256, spectral_slope_ratio=0.898 corroborate). run_full_analysis global flags (contrast/saturation/brightness) are content-dependent false positives of impulse variance/chroma inflation: their combination varies across the 5 support pairs while the impulse fingerprint stays 0.900/10%. noise_impulse:5 scored CI 10/10 on all 5 pairs; impulse:4 control failed impulse metrics by 30% and gaussian_RGB:2 by 95%. PSNR (11.2-12.7 dB) is seed-limited and not a valid discriminator; per SKILL exp37 noise rule the step verdict is UNCERTAIN (never LIKELY) despite MATCH-level CI evidence.
